summary: Allocates a heap buffer for a2 AABB collision bodies (each 32 bytes). Precedes the allocation with PhysicsBufferFree. When a2 > 0, stores the requested count at this+0x4, allocates 32*a2+4 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initializes each 32-byte body slot with AABBCollisionBodyInitializer, and stores the buffer pointer at this+0x8 (null on allocation failure).

operations.description: Call PhysicsBufferFree to free/reset the existing physics buffer before allocation.
Guard on a2 > 0; when no bodies are requested, allocation and buffer setup are skipped.
Store the requested count a2 at this+0x4.
Allocate 32*a2+4 bytes (count header plus body array) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; the pointer becomes the result.
Guard on the allocation result being non-null; on null, set this+0x8 to 0.
Set v5 to the slot pointer one element past the header (result+1), store a2 into the header slot, and seed the loop counter with a2-1.
do-while loop over a2 iterations using a countdown counter, iterating body slots by a 32-byte stride.
Call AABBCollisionBodyInitializer(v6) to initialize each 32-byte AABB body slot.
Store the allocated body array pointer v5 at this+0x8.

unresolved: Owner object of this+0x4 and this+0x8 is unidentified; only the collision-subsystem context is known.
Meaning of the returned pointer value (last AABBCollisionBodyInitializer result or a2-1) for the caller is unknown.
